subject: design/feature-draft-reopen
statement: A plan's traces resolve against memory as of the lock its `Basis` header names (`design:feature-draft-v1` §3.11, S-10). So a requirement retired at a later version stays resolvable for plans generated from earlier versions, and their finished tasks keep tracing the version they delivered (`prd:feature-draft/FR-44`). A plan generated from the new version that traces the retired requirement is refused as an unresolvable trace (`FR-15`, `FR-37`). This closes incident I9's failure for draft-born features (`design-brainstorm:feature-draft-tech-design-2#F-10`, `#F-11`).
